BiblicalUsage: The imitator is the follower, and Paul uses the word as a chain: be followers of me as I am of Christ, and be followers of God as dear children. The Thessalonians became followers of the Lord and of Paul, and Hebrews holds up those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the chain must not break. Christ is the pattern, the apostles copied Him, and the church copies them, so that the next generation can still see what the life looks like.
